export_evidence: ImportKey page for TELENTIRE INC (https://importkey.com/countries/india/telentire-inc) shows only inbound India customs records; no outbound/export bill of lading with an Indian shipper is listed. Counter check: page header states 'Total Shipments 1215 Records detected', 'Trading Partners 2', 'Ports 3'; rows actually visible in the free view = 5 shipment lines, all imports. Exact visible line: '2026-02-18 | ZHUZHOU CEMENTED CARBIDE CUTTING TOOLS CO.,LTD. | TELENTIRE INC | CNMG120412ZMA (YB6425) (COATED CARBIDE INSERTS) | HAIKOU, CHINA -> DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India | 82090090 | BOL 7600607'. Direction is China -> India (import), so it is not evidence of export. No export record with date/destination/HS/BOL found; volza, eximpedia and trademo free views returned HTTP 403 and could not be read.

Only indirect trace of domestic activity: the same ImportKey record shows the company as an Indian consignee at 'DELHI AIR CARGO ACC INDEL4, India' with registered address '396, MEGA AVENUE, OPP.R.K.MACHINE TOOLS, INDUSTRIAL AREA A', i.e. it buys coated carbide inserts and toolholders (HS 82090090, 84661010) into India — consistent with domestic resale, but no domestic supply record (buyer, invoice, tender) was seen. Search engines (DuckDuckGo/searx) were unreachable and Bing returned irrelevant results, so domestic evidence could not be extended.
